# Upstream prints DATE-TIME instances as UTC without a trailing Z (INSTANCES-AS:utc).
# ADVANCE-TO is upstream's advanceTo(), which takes a UTC value.

LIMIT:5
INSTANCES-AS:utc
INSTANCES:20060120,20060121,20060122,20060123,20060124
MORE:yes
